name: Stefilmon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon has 1 digivolution card, you may place up to 2 level 4 or lower yellow Digimon cards from your hand at the bottom of this Digimon's digivolution cards in any order. Then, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) for each Digimon card you placed.
source_effect: [Your Turn] When this card is trashed due to activating this Digimon's ＜Digi-Burst＞, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) for the turn.
